notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 1.8.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After more than a month of work, we are excited to present version 1.8.4 of Chained Together, which introduces a brand new feature many have been waiting for: the creation and sharing of custom maps! This update is designed to unleash your creativity and introduce you to new experiences created by players themselves.

[b]New Features:[/b]

[b]Integrated Map Editor:[/b] Access the map editor directly from the main menu by clicking on the "Workshop" button. Create your own map using a variety of tools designed to facilitate the creation of challenges, interactions, and unique mechanics.

[list]
[*] Challenges: Discover new challenges made possible by the map editor.
[*] Logical Interactions: Add buttons, triggers, and object movement mechanisms.
[*] Environmental Manipulation: You can play with object visibility, their collisions, and even create splines to control movements or craft new environments.
[/list]

[b]Publishing and Updating Maps:[/b] Once your creation is complete, publish it directly from the game to share with the community on the Steam Workshop. Updates to your maps can also be easily managed via the game.

[b]Playing Workshop Modes:[/b]

To play a mode created by the community, first subscribe to it via the "Workshop" button in the startup menu.

When creating the game, select "Workshop" as the game mode and choose from the modes you are subscribed to.

[b]Redesigned Settings Interface:[/b] We have revised the settings interface for more intuitive navigation.

[b][i]Join Our Community on Discord:[/i][/b]

Don't miss out on joining our Discord server to get help, share your creations, and provide feedback for future updates. Your participation helps us evolve the game!

We hope you enjoy these new features and look forward to seeing all your creations!

[i]The Chained Together Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.8.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the new patch 1.8.0 brings some improvements:

[list]
[*] Added a "3,2,1 Go!" function. By pressing 'R', you will be able to signal to other players the exact moment to jump in order to stay synchronized. You can change the key binding under the name "Start Countdown."
[*] Added a version check. If you join a session that does not have the same version as you, a notification will appear upon connection.
[*] Optimization of trees in the city area.
[*] Other optimizations.
[/list]
Have fun!

notes.title: Update (1.7.8)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We've just uploaded an update (1.7.8). 

[list]
[*] We've fixed certain achievements that weren't activating (like the one for the temple). 
[*] We've created a new section in the leaderboard linked to [b]Speedrun.com[/b] that displays runs validated by the community.

If you encounter any difficulties or issues in the game, please don't hesitate to discuss them with us on Discord (bug-report section).

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: New patch (1.7.7)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

we continue to update the game with this patch that fixes a recurring bug when using the reset button in lava mode (we will rethink how the game reloads in future updates for speedrunners). 

We also have a new option that allows hosts to cap the maximum number of players in the session.
We are currently working on translation (Chinese, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and more) but it will be available in a future update.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update for June 25, 2024
notes.notes:
[u][b]A new patch has been released today. [/b][/u]

After reviewing your feedback, here is a list of fixes:

[list]
[*] Added several quality settings (View Distance, Reflection Quality, Effects Quality, Texture Quality, Post-Process Quality, and Anti-Aliasing Quality).
[*] Fixed certain physical platforms that were too low due to framerate issues.
[*] Session passwords are now encrypted. Please ensure your game is updated to version 1.7.6; otherwise, you will not be able to join your friends' sessions.
[*] Some collision issues have been resolved.
[*] Respawn problems have been addressed.
[*] Several minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Feel free to join the Discord if you encounter any problems.

[b]Have Fun![/b]

notes.title: Exciting Game Development Update: New Features and Progress Showcase!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] 

It's been a while since we last posted an update. 

The game has required a lot of work from us. We have finished building the level, but there was a lot of work to do in terms of polishing it. At the same time, we have significantly improved the behavior of the chain that links the players. We are also working on the game's narrative; we've added voice narration throughout the journey. 

Finally, we've made a video that showcases the progress of the project, which you can see here!
